description: Manage browser sessions — list open sessions and your tabs in them, see which tab you work in ("status"), create a new one, or close one (pass your tabId to close only that tab of yours). Use "status" to find your current tab id. When a browser tool's answer starts with "Your tab … was lost; a replacement tab … is open", continue in that tab (no create). Use "create" when your browser session or tab was lost (closed, disconnected, "Session not found", "Tab … not found"): it opens a new tab of your own in the SynaBun browser, starting the browser when it is not running, and in a loop or a dispatched run your next browser calls go to it. Only if create fails too, stop and report it; never switch to another browser. To work in a MoreLogin profile other than the default (a second account, while other automations use the default one), pass moreloginProfile to "create" or call morelogin with action "use": your browser tools then drive that profile in a tab of your own and nobody else is moved (only a profile the owner allowed agents to choose; when it is refused as not on the owner's list, tell the user to switch it on in SynaBun's Settings and stop). Closing a session other automations still use closes only your own tab in it; the session stays open for them. In the owner's everyday browser (the extension, full control) "list" also shows the owner's open tabs; "create" with one of their ids as tabId takes that tab over.

action.description: "list" = the open sessions with your own tabs (id, address, title; your current tab marked), and in the owner's everyday browser with full control also the owner's open tabs you can take over, "status" = the session and tab your browser calls use now, with its address and whether SynaBun replaced a lost tab, "create" = open a new browser tab of your own (starting the browser if needed) and continue there, "close" = close a session.

moreloginProfile.description: "create" only: the MoreLogin profile (its id or its name, as the morelogin tool's "list" shows it) to work in from now on. The new tab opens in that profile and your later browser calls stay there; the default browser and other sessions are not touched. "default" goes back to the default profile. The same as calling morelogin with action "use" first, with the same rule: only a profile the owner allowed agents to choose (morelogin "list" says which); a refusal for a profile not on that list means tell the user to switch it on in SynaBun's Settings, never another profile. Omit it to stay in the profile you work in.

sessionId.description: Session ID for "close" action. Required for close when multiple sessions exist (or pass your tabId).

tabId.description: Your tab id, as the other browser tools take it. "status" / "list": says whether it is still your current tab (a lost tab names the tab that replaced it). "close": closes only this tab of yours; a tab that is not yours is refused and nothing is closed. "create": in the owner's everyday browser with full control, the id of one of the owner's open tabs that "list" shows: you take that tab over (it becomes yours until you close it, and closing it leaves it open for the owner) instead of opening a new one. Otherwise "create" ignores it and opens a new tab of your own.

name: browser_session
